tools.name: checkleaked_site_faq
tools.description: CheckLeaked.cc FAQ: how the service works, plans, payments, API keys, accounts, privacy. Optional keyword query. No API key needed.

tools.name: checkleaked_site_plans
tools.description: CheckLeaked.cc plans and prices (USD): daily lookups, duration, tracking slots, search types. No API key needed.

tools.name: checkleaked_site_breach_search
tools.description: Search the PUBLIC breach catalog by company name or domain (metadata only, never anyone's data). No API key needed.

tools.name: checkleaked_site_breach
tools.description: Details of one PUBLIC breach by its catalog name (from checkleaked_site_breach_search): dates, accounts, exposed data types, description. No API key needed.

tools.name: checkleaked_site_latest_breach
tools.description: The most recently added public breach. No API key needed.

tools.name: checkleaked_site_briefing
tools.description: Today's CheckLeaked.cc cybersecurity briefing: title, summary, key takeaways, story titles, link. No API key needed.

tools.name: checkleaked_site_changelog
tools.description: Recent CheckLeaked.cc changelog entries (what is new or fixed). No API key needed.

tools.name: checkleaked_site_stats
tools.description: Public CheckLeaked.cc numbers: total searches served and indexed breach records. No API key needed.

tools.name: checkleaked_site_pages
tools.description: Useful CheckLeaked.cc pages with what each one is for. No API key needed.

tools.name: checkleaked_verify_auth
tools.description: Verify the API key is valid and return subscription info (role, expiration date)

tools.name: checkleaked_ping
tools.description: Health check — verify API connectivity and key validity

tools.name: checkleaked_leak_check
tools.description: Search the LeakCheck breach database. Supports types: auto, email, username, keyword, domain, phone, hash, password, origin, phash. Legacy: mass, login, pass_email, domain_email, pass_login.

tools.name: checkleaked_dehashed
tools.description: Search the Dehashed breach database by email, username, ip_address, name, address, phone, vin, or free-text

tools.name: checkleaked_experimental
tools.description: Search experimental / Snusbase databases by username, mass, email, lastip, password, name, or hash

tools.name: checkleaked_crack_hash
tools.description: Crack a password hash (MD5, SHA1, SHA256, NTLM, etc.) using rainbow tables and breach data

tools.name: checkleaked_ip_lookup
tools.description: Get geolocation, ISP, and network info for an IP address. Omit IP to look up your own.

tools.name: checkleaked_ghunt
tools.description: OSINT lookup on a Gmail address via Google Hunt — profile info, linked services, profile picture. Requires Pro/Plus subscription.

tools.name: checkleaked_tracking_new
tools.description: Create a new tracking entry to monitor for future data breaches. Uses one of your plan's tracking slots (see checkleaked_tracking_limits).

tools.name: checkleaked_tracking_delete
tools.description: Stop tracking an entry. Pass its `email_unique_id` from checkleaked_tracking_entries (NOT the numeric `id` field).

tools.name: checkleaked_tracking_limits
tools.description: Get your tracking limits (max entries, current usage)

tools.name: checkleaked_tracking_entries
tools.description: List all tracking entries for the authenticated user

tools.name: checkleaked_tracking_history
tools.description: Check history for one tracked entry: every snapshot with its date, found count and changes. Pass the same entry and type it was added with; use a snapshot's `id` with checkleaked_tracking_result for the full result.

tools.name: checkleaked_tracking_result
tools.description: Get the detailed result for one tracking history snapshot (its `id` from checkleaked_tracking_history)

tools.name: checkleaked_tracking_clean
tools.description: Remove stale or invalid tracking entries from your account

tools.name: checkleaked_leakradar_raw_search
tools.description: Search the raw stealer-log corpus. Returns matching BLOCKS, each addressed by container_id + entry_path + seq. Step 1 of the raw flow — feed a result into checkleaked_leakradar_raw_part to read the actual leaked data. Provide `q` and/or at least one filter (container_id, exts, categories, file_name)

tools.name: checkleaked_leakradar_raw_parts
tools.description: List the sequential blocks (parts) available for one raw entry, so you can page through a large file and pick a seq to read. Uses container_id + entry_path from a raw search result.

tools.name: checkleaked_leakradar_raw_part
tools.description: Read the content of ONE specific raw block by container_id + entry_path + seq — this is how you see the actual leaked data for a single hit. If the block is locked the text comes back redacted (censored=true, █); auto_unlock=true (default) reveals the plaintext and costs a credit.

tools.name: checkleaked_leakradar_raw_search_lines
tools.description: Search raw stealer logs, unlock the matched blocks, and return the parsed leak records matching the query in one call. Use this instead of raw_search+raw_part when you want the actual credentials/cookies rather than block metadata. Pro plan; costs 1 credit per call.

tools.name: checkleaked_leakradar_email_search
tools.description: Search credential leaks for an email address or username. Masked rows auto-unlock by default (costs credits); set auto_unlock=false for a masked preview. Costs credits (Plus/Pro).

tools.name: checkleaked_leakradar_advanced_search
tools.description: Advanced credential-leak search with structured filters (username/password/url/email facets, strength, date window). Each field is an array; set force_and=true for AND within a field. Costs credits (Plus/Pro).

tools.name: checkleaked_leakradar_domain_summary
tools.description: Aggregate breach exposure for a domain (employees / customers / third-parties counts). Use light=true for just the headline counts.

tools.name: checkleaked_leakradar_dark_web_search
tools.description: Search indexed dark-web forum/market posts by a simple query or advanced field filters. Requires Plus/Pro. Costs credits.

tools.name: checkleaked_leakradar_pwned
tools.description: Check whether a password appears in breach data. Send `password` (hashed server-side, never logged) OR a precomputed uppercase 40-char `sha1`. Returns { pwned, count }.

tools.name: checkleaked_leakradar_password_range
tools.description: Return the breach-occurrence range for a SHA-1 hash prefix (>=5 hex chars) — a low-cost k-anonymity building block. Never send the full hash.

tools.name: checkleaked_leakradar_unlock
tools.description: Unlock specific leak records by their ids (from a search result's items[].id). Charged per record unlocked; ids already unlocked account-wide are claimed at no charge.

tools.name: checkleaked_leakradar_task_status
tools.description: Get the status of a LeakRadar background task (async unlock / export). Poll until completed / running=false.

tools.name: checkleaked_domain_whois
tools.description: WHOIS / registration lookup for a domain — registrar, creation/expiry dates, name servers, status. Uses your API key.

tools.name: checkleaked_breach_info
tools.description: Registry record for ONE breach by name (HIBP-style: Name, Title, Domain, BreachDate, PwnCount, DataClasses, Description, Sources). Open route, no credits. Pass `lang` for a translated description.

tools.name: checkleaked_breaches_search
tools.description: Search the breach registry by name/domain/description. Paginated; returns { items, total }. Open route, no credits.

tools.name: checkleaked_pwned_password
tools.description: Check whether a password appears in known breaches WITHOUT sending it: the SHA-1 is computed inside the MCP process, only its first 5 hex chars are sent (k-anonymity range query, HIBP-style) and the suffix is matched locally. Returns { pwned, count, prefix }. Free public route, no credits; the passw

tools.name: checkleaked_email_breach_kanon
tools.description: Free breach teaser for an email address WITHOUT sending the address: SHA-256 of the lowercased, trimmed email is computed inside the MCP process and only its first 24 hex chars are sent. Returns { found, sources[], fields[] } — no passwords or records (use checkleaked_leak_check for full results). N

tools.name: checkleaked_name_insight
tools.description: Gender, origin and meaning insight for a personal name found in a leak (offline dictionary + Wikidata/Wikipedia). Open route, no credits.

tools.name: checkleaked_news_latest
tools.description: Latest CheckLeaked cybersecurity briefing (daily news post). Open route, no credits. Pass `lang` for a translated post.

tools.name: checkleaked_webhook_get
tools.description: Show the account's tracking webhook — url, enabled, secret_hint (last 4 chars), fail_count, last_status / last_error / last_attempt / last_success — or null when none is configured. The secret itself is never returned here; only checkleaked_webhook_set returns it, on create or rotate. Destination: H

tools.name: checkleaked_webhook_set
tools.description: Create or update the account's tracking webhook. The response carries the plaintext `secret` ONLY when the webhook is created or rotate_secret=true — store it then, it cannot be read back later. Destination: HTTPS only, on a public host (no private/loopback IPs, no localhost). Events: `tracking.find

tools.name: checkleaked_webhook_test
tools.description: Send one signed test `tracking.finding` event (payload test=true) to the configured webhook, no retries. Returns { delivered, status, error, duration_ms }. Limited to 5 per minute. Destination: HTTPS only, on a public host (no private/loopback IPs, no localhost). Events: `tracking.finding` — one JSO

tools.name: checkleaked_webhook_delete
tools.description: Delete the account's tracking webhook: stops all deliveries and discards the secret.

tools.name: checkleaked_private_bots_get
tools.description: List the account's private Discord / Telegram bots — per platform: state (stopped / starting / online / error), enabled, bot_username, bot_id, token_hint (last 4 chars), last_error, last_started and invite_url (Discord) — plus plan_ok (Pro / Plus required), configured (server-side token key present)

tools.name: checkleaked_private_bot_set
tools.description: Create, replace or pause/resume the account's private bot on one platform. Pass `token` to (re)store a token — validated first, saved encrypted, never echoed back. Pass `enabled` alone (no token) to pause (false) or resume (true) an existing bot. Returns { bot } with state, bot_username, token_hint

tools.name: checkleaked_private_bot_delete
tools.description: Remove the account's private bot on one platform: stops it and discards the encrypted token. Returns { removed: true }.
